items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: a friend of mine named Lil Davis played trombone, he took me up there.

ctx.x: And the band never took an intermission. One would get off at a time. Oh, and one of them, Chester, he played all of the instruments, and so he would relieve everyone, you know. So I went up there, a friend of mine named Lil Davis played trombone, he took me up there. But the regular bass player was a -- of Spanish descent, his name was Louis Gonzalez, I think. Or I might be mistaking him for the guitarist with King Cole.
Well, anyway, he was Spanish. And he would be glad to see me coming. And Chester would be glad to see me come, you know, because it would give him a chance to play some drums, sometimes, you know.
